desc: The Patriot series of firearm cases by Allen has been designed with a custom camo pattern developed in-house. The red, white, and blue camo colors are throughout the line of handgun and rifle cases. Patriot cases are stitched together using durable Endura fabric with a soft knit lining and thick foam padding to protect your firearm. Show off your Patriotism knowing these cases were designed and made in the USA by Allen.
